author: dentmaged
body: I should have got a warn for excessive caps, and I got two kicks from trolling, then I stopped, so why did I get a ban?
body_tagged: I should have got a warn for excessive caps, and I got two kicks from trolling, then I stopped, so why did I get a ban?
title: False ban

replies.author: Spoookeh
replies.body:
Hey there dent,

You should have been temp banned after your first offence for team trolling. However I gave you the benefit of the doubt and kicked you instead. You then continued to troll and started to use excessive caps unnecessarily. Therefore this punishment is not false and will stand. 

If you have any concerns please feel to ask on this thread. 

- Spookeh

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Regarding your first kick, you dug a hole in front of your team's spawn. The players that were exiting the spawn will eventually fall in it and then dig/build out of the hole.
It slows your team down so they can't get fast enough to the frontlines or the monument to defend it.
And since you were breaking the bridge that the players built to get over the hole, you were trolling/griefing your team in form of trapping them in the hole.
